reviews.t: Good overall quality but bad design
reviews.x: This is the third of Norelco's waterproof series that I have owned. The overall quality is just as good as previous models and other Philips/Norelco products. The shaver is constructed well and is lighter and more compact than previous models. Charging and battery life also seem to be very good.  The main problem I find with this new design is that the heads/razors are floating and not encased as previous models and most other shavers. When using this shaver in the shower this is not a problem.

I've never found a single electric razor that shaves as close as a blade, but I used to own a Norelco Advantage that gave a decently close shave that was pretty comfortable and didn't irritate my neck. The new Norelco 8060x Coolskin is far better than the old 7xxx series in practically every way.  The old models shaved very close, but irritated my skin and left me red and inflamed.  The new model on the other hand shaves just as close, but is also extremely comfortable, and doesn't leave my skin irritated, even during the regrowth phase. reviews.t: Love the shaver...Holder is a total waste
reviews.x: Have been using a Phillips lotion shaver for several years. I think the shave is close and comfy. This new one is great like all of them. Save your money and don't buy the charger/auto  filler. Easier and faster (and cheaper) to fill manually, and charge in the included holder. 5 stars if they didn't tell you how great the auto fill is so they can squeeze a little more out of ya. When this one dies I will buy the newer model...Happy Shaving

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the close, comfortable shave and say it outperforms older Norelco models.
The moisturizing lotion dispensing system is widely liked and makes skin feel soft, though some note it only works reliably when functioning.
Some users report skin irritation or a rough break-in period before the shaver becomes comfortable.
A few reviewers complain that clippings spill out of the head, requiring shaving over a sink or in the shower.
Cleaning the cutter and blade assembly is described as difficult.
